eventDetail.scope: The 4th IEEE International Conference on Agrosystem Engineering, Technology & Applications  (AGRETA 2026) brings together academia, industry and government to exchange the very  latest advances in engineering solutions for sustainable agriculture. It encompasses the design,  development and deployment of smart, automated and data-driven agrosystems that boost  productivity, ensure food security, minimize environmental impact and improve resource  efficiency.
